description: This file defines a Flutter widget called WinPulse, which wraps a child widget and applies a subtle pulsing scale animation when enabled. It manages animation state internally and controls the animation based on the enabled flag.

classes.name: WinPulse
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that applies a pulsing scale animation to its child when enabled.

classes.name: _WinPulseState
classes.description: State class managing the animation controller and building the animated widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and scale animation, starts animation if enabled.

methods.name: didUpdateWidget
methods.description: Updates animation state based on changes to the enabled property.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the animation controller when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, applying the scale transformation if enabled.
